design.source: negative-path fixture: same as op_amp_unity but component value is TESTOP_SUPPRESS, whose spec declares BOTH an ac_model (op-amp) AND a per-pin dc_model on OUT (driven 5.0V). The ac_model MUST win — VOUT should read ~1.0V (op-amp behavior), not 5.0V (driven behavior). If suppression regresses, this fires.
